grammarFocus: 过去进行时入门；when / while；who / which / that 定语从句入门。
title: A Spring Festival Visit
instructions: 请听一段关于春节拜访的对话，然后回答10个问题。对话会播放两遍。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Mei: Hi, Grandma! I'm here. Happy Spring Festival!
Grandma: Mei! Come in, come in. Your grandfather is in the kitchen. He is putting dumplings in a pot.
Mei: Great! I love dumplings. Where is Mom?
Grandma: She is on the phone. She is talking to your uncle. He is in Shanghai.
Mei: Oh, I see. And what were you doing when I called you this morning?
Grandma: I was cleaning the windows. Your grandfather was washing the vegetables. We were both busy.
Mei: I called at ten o'clock. Was Grandpa cooking then?
Grandma: No, he wasn't. He was washing vegetables. He usually doesn't cook. I do the cooking.
Mei: Ha ha! Grandpa is a good helper.
Grandma: Yes, he is. Now, sit down. The dumplings are almost ready.
Mei: Grandma, who is the woman in the photo on the wall?
Grandma: That is my sister. She lives in Beijing. She is a teacher.
Mei: The photo which is next to the window? She looks like you.
Grandma: Yes, that one. She visited us last year. We had a big dinner.
Mei: I remember. The dinner that we had was delicious.
Grandpa: Mei! The dumplings are ready! Come and eat!
Mei: Coming, Grandpa! Grandma, thank you for the tea.
Grandma: You're welcome, dear. Let's eat together.

questions.prompt: What is Grandpa doing when Mei arrives?
options: He is putting dumplings in a pot.
He is talking on the phone.
answers: He is putting dumplings in a pot.
questions.explanation: 对话开头奶奶说“Your grandfather is in the kitchen. He is putting dumplings in a pot.”，所以爷爷正在把饺子放进锅里。
questions.evidence: Your grandfather is in the kitchen. He is putting dumplings in a pot.

questions.prompt: Who is Mom talking to on the phone?
questions.explanation: 奶奶说“She is talking to your uncle.”，所以妈妈正在和叔叔通电话。
questions.evidence: She is talking to your uncle.

questions.prompt: What was Grandma doing when Mei called this morning?
questions.explanation: Mei问“what were you doing when I called you this morning?”，奶奶回答“I was cleaning the windows.”，所以奶奶当时在擦窗户。

questions.prompt: What was Grandpa doing when Mei called this morning?
options: He was putting dumplings in a pot.
questions.explanation: 奶奶说“Your grandfather was washing the vegetables.”，指的是Mei早上打电话的时候，所以爷爷当时在洗菜。注意：把饺子放进锅里是Mei到达时爷爷正在做的事，不是打电话时。
questions.evidence: Your grandfather was washing the vegetables.

questions.prompt: What time did Mei call this morning?
questions.explanation: Mei说“I called at ten o'clock.”，所以Mei是早上十点打的电话。
奶奶说“He usually doesn't cook. I do the cooking.”，所以通常是奶奶做饭。
questions.evidence: He usually doesn't cook. I do the cooking.

questions.prompt: Who is the woman in the photo on the wall?
questions.explanation: Mei问照片里的女人是谁，奶奶回答“That is my sister.”，所以照片里的人是奶奶的姐姐或妹妹。
奶奶说“She lives in Beijing.”，所以奶奶的姐姐或妹妹住在北京。
奶奶说“She is a teacher.”，所以奶奶的姐姐或妹妹是一名教师。
对话中奶奶明确说“He usually doesn't cook.”，与题目“Grandpa usually cooks dinner.”直接矛盾，因此答案是False。

vocabulary.example: He is putting dumplings in a pot.
He is putting dumplings in a pot.
Your grandfather was washing the vegetables.
Who is the woman in the photo on the wall?
The dinner that we had was delicious.

grammar.title: 过去进行时与定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作，结构是 was/were + 动词-ing。常与 when（当……时）或 while（在……期间）连用。定语从句用来修饰名词，who 指人，which 指物，that 指人或物。
grammar.example: I was cleaning the windows. / The photo which is next to the window?

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，过去进行时用 was + 动词-ing，表示昨晚8点正在看电视。
questions.evidence: At 8 p.m. yesterday, I was watching TV.

questions.prompt: While she ________, the lights went out.
questions.explanation: while 引导的从句常用过去进行时，主语 she 是单数，用 was reading。
questions.evidence: While she was reading, the lights went out.

questions.prompt: The man ________ is talking to my father is our teacher.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the man 指人，定语从句用 who 引导。
questions.evidence: The man who is talking to my father is our teacher.

questions.prompt: This is the book ________ I bought yesterday.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the book 指物，选项中 that 可以引导定语从句，who 指人，where 指地点，when 指时间。
questions.evidence: This is the book that I bought yesterday.

part1: What do you usually do during Spring Festival?
Who do you visit during holidays?
Do you like cooking? Why or why not?
What did you do last weekend?
speaking.part2: Describe a family member you visited recently. You should say: who this person is; where they live; what you did together; and explain why you visited them.
part3: Why do people visit family during holidays?
How have family traditions changed in your country?
Do you think it is important to spend time with family? Why?
What can people do to keep family traditions alive?

transfer.writing: Write a short paragraph (about 80 words) about a holiday visit you made. Use past continuous tense and at least one relative clause with who, which, or that.
